about: Student, I am enrolled in a Computer Science Teaching Degree at the Federal Institute of Bahia, Sr. do Bonfim campus. I am also a scholarship holder in the Tutorial Education Program (PET), and our group's goal is to disseminate and promote Media Literacy. With 5 years of experience as a Developer, I have worked on projects involving dashboards, service management, sales control, landing pages, and SaaS in general. My main technologies include: NextJS, ReactJS, TypeScript, Express, and NestJS. I have knowledge in Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and TDD. I am communicative and enjoy helping, as well as valuing transparency in information. I learn and adapt quickly to changes.
